description: Genuine self-contained one-transaction BN254 Groth16 verifier laid out as the 13 linked INPUTS of ONE transaction (intra-tx forward-checking via OP_INPUTBYTECODE). Tokenless (no NFT covenant), runtime-general (byte-identical lockings verify any proof for the canonical VK), fairly scored (all state in on-wire witness bytes).
method: intra-tx linked inputs (OP_INPUTBYTECODE forward-pinned witness thread; no NFT-commitment hand-off, no token). State passed as raw byte blobs bound by direct byte equality across sibling inputs.
deployment: P2SH32 (each input reveals its redeem in the scriptSig); input 0 = 2-byte lib bare push.
canonicalVk: src/checkpoints/pairing-vectors.json (same fixed Groth16 statement as the other BN254 entries; vk_x = IC0 + in0*IC1 + in1*IC2)
